1.w: And the man knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain and said, “I have acquired a man by YHWH.”

2.w: And she continued to give birth [to] his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, and Cain was a worker of the ground.

3.w: And it came to pass at the end of days that Cain brought some of the fruit of the ground an offering to YHWH.

4.w: And Abel, he also brought from the firstborn of his flock, even from their fat. And YHWH looked with favor unto Abel and unto his offering.

5.w: And to Cain and to his offering He did not look with favor, and it burned to Cain exceedingly, and his face fell.

6.w: And YHWH said to Cain, “Why has it burned to you, and why has your face fallen?

7.w: Is it not [that] if you do well, [there is] elevation? But if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door; and its desire [is] for you, and you must rule over it.”

8.w: And Cain said to Abel his brother, [ “Let us go into the field.” ] And it came to pass in their being in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.

9.w: And YHWH said to Cain, “Where [is] Abel your brother?” And He said, “I do not know. [Am] I my brother’s keeper?”

10.w: And He said, “What have you done? The voice of the bloods of your brother is crying out to Me from the ground!

11.w: And now, cursed [are] you from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive the bloods of your brother from your hand.

12.w: When you work the ground, it shall not continue to give its strength to you. You shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

13.w: And Cain said to YHWH, “Greater [is] my punishment than I can bear!

14.w: Behold, You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground, and from Your face I shall be hidden, and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. And it will come to pass [that] anyone finding me will kill me!”

15.w: And YHWH said to him, “Not so; anyone who kills Cain, sevenfold shall vengeance be taken on him.” And YHWH set on Cain a mark, lest anyone finding him [should] slay him.

16.w: And Cain went out from before the face of YHWH and dwelt in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

17.w: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. And he began building a city, and he called the name of the city according to the name of his son, Enoch.

18.w: And to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad begat Mehujael, and Mehujael begat Methushael, and Methushael begat Lamech.

19.w: And Lamech took for himself two wives: The name of the one [was] Adah, and the name of the second [was] Zillah.

20.w: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those dwelling in tents and [having] livestock.

21.w: And the name of his brother [was] Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.

22.w: And Zillah, she also bore Tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain [was] Naamah.

23.w: And Lamech said to his wives: “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, give ear to my speech: For a man I have killed for my wound, and a young man for my bruise.

24.w: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy and sevenfold!”

25.w: And Adam again knew his wife, and she gave birth to a son and called his name Seth, “For God has appointed for me another seed in place of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

26.w: And to Seth, [to] him also a son was born, and he called his name Enosh. At that time they began to call on the name of YHWH.
